text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND (drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%diabetes mellitus, type 2%' OR drug_indication.efo_term LIKE '%type 2 diabetes%').
